Ok. There are definitely some crazy people, but this remains true.


ZUBY: (@ZubyMusic)

What shocks me whenever I come to the USA is how much BETTER the place and people are in real life compared to what gets amplified on social media.

This is true almost everywhere, but because so much online 'content' originates from the US, it's particularly striking.



— https://nitter.net/ZubyMusic/status/2048071770230427909#m

This is insane to me.


Tyler Todt (@tyromper)

I don't understand the boomers that hoard all their wealth from their kids.

I have a good buddy that's struggling.
Married with a few kids.

He's smart. Graduated university with great grades, got hired by a good company, & did everything "right."

He got laid off over a year ago & told me he's sent 10,000 resumes in with no job offerings.....

He's working side gigs but his family is stressed.

His folks are retired & in their 70's.

What shocks me whenever I come to the USA is how much BETTER the place and people are in real life compared to what gets amplified on social media.

This is true almost everywhere, but because so much online 'content' originates from the US, it's particularly striking.

I remember when people used to smoke on planes.

Seems like a terrible idea in hindsight.

I had an interesting conversation with investigative journalist @AshleyRindsberg about how Wikipedia was hijacked and its long term impacts.

You can listen to the full interview on the Real Talk with Zuby podcast. Out today.

piped.video/cCov3oXzPmI?si=tPRd…

It feels good to be back in the USA! 🇺🇸

If I post good things about the country while I'm here, I wonder if I'll be accused of being 'paid by the government' again. 🤣

I've been to Dubai, New York City, and Miami... Today. So have my wife and son.

Thank God for safe travels. Some sleep would be wonderful soon :)

Isn't that lower than the UK?


David Parker (@david_parker)

The median income for a Canadian is $42,600 CAD a year.  I have absolutely no clue how a person survives in the modern world on this kind of income. It is incomprehensible to me.



— https://nitter.net/david_parker/status/2047349252884726080#m

It takes incredible propaganda to convince a population that enforcing border policy is 'racist' or 'cruel'.

There's basically no country on Earth where you can just waltz in unannounced and stay there indefinitely.

Bro, what is happening?
